When an interface enforces implementation of the magic __serialize() and __unserialize() methods and the code base does not need to support PHP < 7.4, the interface no longer needs to extend the Serializable interface.

The "Serializable" interface extends the serializable serializable interface. For the PHPCompatibility.Interface.RemovedSerializable sniff to be reliable, the name of this interface needs to be added to the list of interface implementations to find. Please add the interface name "Serializable" to the "serializableInterfaces" property for this sniff in your custom ruleset and rescan the codebase.
